description: Read the shop defaults stored for this installation: how long a job runs, how wide an arrival window is, and the line item most jobs start from. Read them before proposing a booking, so a preference the shop confirmed once does not have to be asked for again. These are this installation's own preferences, kept in a file on the machine the server runs on rather than in Housecall Pro. Nothing here is read from Housecall Pro or sent to it. An empty answer means none has been set, which is the ordinary state of a fresh install.
name: hcp_get_defaults
